harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 as a passive-only FTP dropbox for node2’s scanner account. Uploads, downloads, sample integrity, confinement, anonymous denial, and persistence across sequential node restarts were verified. RHEL release and kernel remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Installed the RHEL-supported vsftpd 3.0.5 package on node1.
Created the staged scanner account with a non-login shell and root-owned chroot containing a dedicated writable dropbox.
Restricted authentication to the scanner account and disabled anonymous and active-mode FTP.
Restricted firewall access to node2 and passive ports 30000–30009; retained SELinux enforcing mode with scoped labels and booleans.

Disabled vsftpd’s seccomp option after audit evidence showed the RHEL build killed passive EPSV operations on `setsockopt`; chroot, SELinux, account allow-list, non-login shell, and firewall isolation remain active.
Uploaded and retrieved the supplied sample, verified SHA-256 equality, retrieved the staged existing file, and denied traversal and anonymous access.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually and verified changed boot identities and full recovery.

evidence.requirement: Supported software with operating-system release and kernel preserved
evidence.summary: Both nodes remain RHEL 10.0 on kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0; node1 runs the RHEL AppStream vsftpd package.

evidence.requirement: Dedicated scanner account and confined writable dropbox
evidence.summary: Shows the non-login account, root-owned chroot, scanner-owned dropbox, SELinux labels, passive configuration, anonymous denial, and enabled service.

evidence.requirement: Passive upload and retrieval, including supplied sample
evidence.summary: node2 uploaded and downloaded the sample through EPSV passive ports with matching SHA-256 and retrieved the existing staged file.

evidence.requirement: Host files inaccessible and anonymous access unavailable
evidence.summary: Authenticated root listing contained only `dropbox`; traversal outside the chroot and anonymous login were denied before and after restarts.
Captures healthy baseline boot ID, restart acknowledgement and disconnect, changed boot ID, restored FTP service/security/data, and successful post-restart retrieval.
Captures healthy baseline boot ID and staged data, restart acknowledgement and disconnect, changed boot ID, restored SSH/data, and successful post-restart FTP and confinement checks.
